diagnosis.inferred: The fork-level suppression caused the original disabled-repository rejection; removing it restored dispatch without changing workflow source, ordinary Actions permissions, billing, or main.
diagnosis.unknown: The prepared expanded workflow and subsequent source changes still require their own hosted run; baseline success does not qualify them.
